title: Our Rabbis in the South
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman identifies them as Rabbi Meir, Rabbi Yehudah, Rabbi Yose, Rabbi Shimon and Rabbi Elazar ben Shamua, as in [Yevamot 62b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.62b.10).[^1]
In the generations of the first Amoraim, Hyman identifies the designation with Rabbi Afes and cites Eruvin 62b.[^2]

notes.text: Yevamot names the five southern students of Rabbi Akiva, including Rabbi Elazar ben Shamua.

The [printed notice](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/ba/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._III._1910.pdf#page=254) cites Eruvin 62b. At [Eruvin 65b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.65b.15-18), Resh Lakish proposes consulting “our Rabbis in the South,” and Rabbi Afes later approves the rental. Hyman cites 65b in his [entry on Resh Lakish](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/ba/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._III._1910.pdf#page=363). [Heilprin’s Resh Lakish entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3460&lang=en) quotes the same exchange.
